title: Customer name is plain text; the invoice link never turns visited-purple
preconds: 1. You have expanded down to invoice detail rows and have already clicked at least one invoice link earlier in the session..
steps:
1. Try clicking the customer NAME on a summary row.
2. Look at an invoice number link at rest, on hover, and one you have already visited.
expected:
1. The customer name on the summary row is plain text, not a link.
2. The invoice number link is shown in the application's primary color at rest, on hover, and after it has been clicked.
3. The link has no underline at rest, on hover, or after it has been clicked.
4. The link never recolors to the browser's visited-link (purple) color.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S9-R5, S9-R6, S9-R7, S9-R8), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - waiting on the product owner to decide whether the invoice number is a clickable link (it currently shows as plain non-clickable text and the specification is contradictory); this test depends on that decision
